title: archive: fix draining pgzip streams after tar EOF
body:
## Summary
- Update vendored pgzip to the merged upstream fix that resets the buffered read offset after the final block.
- Add a regression test for draining a gzip-compressed tar stream after the tar reader reaches EOF.

The new test reproduced the pgzip panic before the dependency update and passes with this change.

Fixes #29944

comments.body: I’ve requested a release containing the fix in https://github.com/klauspost/pgzip/issues/74#issuecomment-6306958637. Once it’s tagged, I’ll update this PR to use the released version.

The new upstream release was done in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30014 via renovate already so it will be part of podman 6.2.

As such we would only need the test, I however do not believe this test in its current form gives us anything. It is testing code in a package that has nothing to do with this at all. It should be a e2e or apiv2 test or none at all IMO.
